UTI Trade School: Training Built for Your Future

You’ve got goals, and we’re here to help you reach them. 1 At Universal Technical Institute (UTI), you can prepare for your future faster than a 4-year college. Explore how we can help make it happen.
Get a Firsthand Look at UTI

Picture yourself in a supportive student community at a technical training school where small classes encourage focused learning. In hands-on labs, passionate instructors will guide you in using the same tools and equipment as techs in the field. 18 You’ll tackle challenges that mirror the real world while developing skills to get closer to where you want to be. See it for yourself.

pages.raw_meta: Universal Technical Institute, Inc. is a leading provider of technical training in trades from automotive to welding. Learn more about our programs here.
raw_blocks: Founded in 1965 and headquartered in Phoenix, Universal Technical Institute's mission is to serve our students, partners, and communities by providing quality education and support services for in-demand careers. Approximately 285,000 students have graduated from UTI's campuses located across the U.S.
We serve students, partners and communities by providing quality education and training for in-demand careers.
To change the world one life at a time by helping people achieve their dreams. This is the underlying reason for our existence and the reason we come to work every day.
UTI's campuses are accredited by the Accrediting Commission of Career Schools and Colleges (ACCSC), an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education.
WE'RE HERE FOR YOUR SUCCESS
Our values drive our reputation. Our reputation is the basis of our growing brand. Making our brand more powerful is essential to achieving our vision.
We strive to make a positive difference in the lives of the people we impact – students, industry partners, employees, shareholders and the communities in which we live and work.
We act with the highest ethical standards, treating everyone with respect.
We succeed by working together.
We embrace change and continuous improvement.
We deliver meaningful outcomes for our students and stakeholders.

Get Started With These Resources

UTI trade school locations team with Compass Rose and Collegiate Housing Services to assist students with relocation. From identifying nearby apartment options to roommate connections, we can help you make a smooth transition.

You can apply for relocation and commuter grants that help make training at the campus you want possible. 10 Start by checking out if you qualify for the Relocation Grant , Institutional Grant or Commuter Grant.

UTI’s Career Services team can help you search for part-time work that fits with your class schedule and is near campus. 1 Most campuses also team with local employers who offer qualified students the chance to start their careers while still in school. 36
